companyFieldUpdates.description: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America LLC (NGPL) is a major U.S. interstate natural-gas transmission and storage company serving producers, utilities, marketers, power generators, industrial users and LNG-linked markets. Kinder Morgan's audited 2025 reporting lists approximately 9,105 miles of pipeline, 8.40 Bcf/d of design capacity and 288 Bcf of storage capacity. The network spans nine states and connects major U.S. supply basins with Midwest demand centers and Texas and Louisiana Gulf Coast markets. NGPL provides firm, flexible-firm and interruptible transportation, multiple storage products, balancing, park-and-loan and line-pack services. ArcLight-controlled funds own 62.5%, across separate Fund VII and Fund VIII investments, while Kinder Morgan owns 37.5% and operates the system. Brookfield fully exited in May 2025, and no later NGPL-specific sale or pending ownership change was identified through August 13, 2026.
